work.name: Fluid Attacks
work.summary: Working on enhancing cybersecurity tools for reporting vulnerabilities using DAST, SAST, CSPM, and SCA techniques.
highlights: • Leveraged GitLab Runner, Terraform, and AWS to build a robust, fully automated CI/CD pipeline for a GitLab project from scratch, ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational efficiency throughout the development lifecycle.
• Maintainer of the CSPM module in Fluid Attacks' vulnerability scanner: Responsible for managing and improving the module's performance, vulnerability coverage, documentation and testing.
• Enhanced execution times by 80%: This improvement significantly increased the speed at which value is delivered to clients and resulted in reduced operational costs.
• Expanded vulnerability coverage: Achieved substantial growth in the number and variety of vulnerabilities reported, covering services like AWS, Azure, and GCP.
• Defined documentation: Elaborate comprehensive documentation detailing the functionality and operational guidelines for the CSPM module.
• Vulnerability resolutions: Actively involved in resolving vulnerabilities reported by the tool, contributing to the security improvements.
• Proposing new features and improvements: Engaged in cross-functional efforts to not only address jplatform issues but also propose new features and seek ways to enhance the product.
